verdict.rationale: A Git forge could plausibly ship built-in AI features that consume external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The pack shows no such MCP-client capability in Gitea. The official gitea-mcp project is an MCP server that exposes Gitea to other agents, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
